_deal: The board's test node. Which Infestation node deals it (the two hold one pool) is Eliza's, her letter.
author: jessica
source: Eliza's letter 2026-10-26 (office/correspondence/2026-10-26-eliza-jessica-infestations-for-the-board.md), on his week goal: "This week I'd like to have at least one of each of the new missions set and the old in the legacy nodes."
_note: THE INFESTATION FAMILY, 1 OF 2: PREDATORS AT A HOME. His MB16 (surface predators, 13 originals), the plain one:
go where animals have taken over, kill them, leave. Voice on the clear, from the client (mission-types.md, type 3).
A lived-in built site, so the stake is people who cannot go home. One species, as a Hunt: the megalist's one-species pick.
Builds on a board today: one request, one clear, the arrival broadcast and a closing line. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: A non-hostile built site, where somebody lives; the lint measures what a request can place.
place._residents: His 2026-10-26: every site in this pool carries a resident tag, so they die when the first radio call plays (place.residents).
place._pool: 24 on 2026-10-26, under Overtime's narrowest (44). Widening to every built non-dungeon site gives 40, but that adds hostile sites whose own occupants fight too, and the words are about people who live there. Kept narrow; his call.

prose.name: Infestation: Predators at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Predators have moved into the <Place>, and the people who live there have been sleeping somewhere else for a week.
prose.card: Infestation contract. Predators have moved into the <Place> on <Planet>, and the people who live there can't get back in. Clear them out. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Clear the predators out of the <Place>
beats.journal: Predators had taken over the <Place>. They're dead, every one, and the people who live there can go home.
say: That's all of them? You're sure?
Then we're going home. I'm sleeping in my own bed tonight.

broadcast: You're there? Good. Don't go in like you're visiting.
They came in one night and never left.
There's more of them than you'd think, and they don't scare.
_speech: Someone who lives there, tired and a little wry. Killian, already in three recipes; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
